title: Compute total DOS of undoped TiSe2
action: Perform a self-consistent DFT calculation for the primitive unit cell of TiSe2 (space group P-3m1) at a lattice constant of about 6.67 a.u. (or 6.7 a.u.). Compute the total density of states on a fine energy grid relative to the Fermi energy. Save the data as two columns: energy (Ry, relative to EF) and total DOS (states/Ry/cell).
description: Total DOS of undoped TiSe2 to verify the low N(EF) and sharp DOS shoulder just above EF.
output_schema: Columns: Energy_Ry (float, energy relative to E_F in Ry), Total_DOS_states_per_Ry_cell (float).

title: Compute total DOS of CuTi12Se24 at a=6.7 a.u.
action: Set up a 2×2×3 supercell of CuTi12Se24 (one Cu intercalated) with lattice constants a = 6.7 a.u., c = 11.35 a.u.. Perform a self-consistent DFT calculation and compute the total DOS on a fine energy grid relative to EF. Save the data as energy (Ry) and total DOS (states/Ry/cell).
description: Total DOS of the supercell at the experimental volume, showing the high narrow peak near EF due to Cu-d–Ti-d hybridization.

title: Compute total DOS of CuTi12Se24 at a=6.67 a.u.
action: Repeat the supercell calculation with lattice constant a = 6.67 a.u. (c scaled proportionally from the a=6.7 a.u. value). Compute the total DOS and save as before.
description: Total DOS at the intermediate volume.

title: Compute total DOS of CuTi12Se24 at a=6.53 a.u.
action: Repeat the supercell calculation with lattice constant a = 6.53 a.u. (c scaled proportionally). Compute the total DOS and save as before.
description: Total DOS at the smallest volume, where the Cu-d peak is pushed above EF and N(EF) is strongly reduced.

title: Extract site-projected DOS at EF and compile table
action: From the three supercell DFT calculations, extract the site-projected density of states at EF for Cu d, Ti_Cu (Ti near Cu), and Ti (Ti far from Cu). Compile the results as a table with lattice constant, site label, and N(EF) in states/(Ry·atom).
description: Table matching the paper's Table II: site-resolved N(EF) at the three lattice constants.
output_schema: Columns: a0 (float, lattice constant in a.u.), site (string, one of 'Cu_d', 'Ti_Cu_d', 'Ti_d'), N_EF_states_per_Ry_atom (float).

title: Compute superconducting and magnetic properties
action: For each of the three lattice constants: (1) obtain the total N(EF) in states/(Ry·cell) from the total DOS curves; (2) compute the electron-phonon coupling λ using the rigid-ion approximation with the given Debye temperatures (240, 250, 290 K) and the experimental phonon moment scaling; (3) compute superconducting Tc from λ via the McMillan-Allen-Dynes equation with μ* = 0.13; (4) compute the Stoner factor S from the paramagnetic N(EF) using the exchange integral for Ti d; (5) compute the electronic specific heat coefficient γ (including λ enhancement). Save one row per lattice constant in a table.
description: Table of derived properties matching the paper's Table I: λ, Tc, S, γ, and total N(EF) at each lattice constant.
output_schema: Columns: a0 (float, lattice constant in a.u.), lambda (float), Tc_K (float, superconducting critical temperature in K), Stoner_S (float, Stoner factor), gamma_mJ_per_mol_K2 (float, electronic specific heat coefficient in mJ/(mol·K²)), N_EF_total_states_per_Ry_cell (float).
